synopsis: A runaway prince sparks a continent-wide revolution that forces him to choose between peace, power, and the people he loves most.

episodes.title: Re; Prologue
episodes.synopsis: A farmer's son, young Ariel, vows to overthrow Imperia's corrupt monarchy after witnessing his father's murder, setting a dark legacy in motion.

episodes.title: The Lands Next Door
episodes.synopsis: Prince Soron volunteers to sail to hostile Omperia with his sister Lilith, while his father Ariel's imperial ambitions begin to strain his family.

episodes.title: Princess of Imperia
episodes.synopsis: Soron argues that violence is necessary for change, inadvertently using his sister's own philosophy against her in a painful confrontation.

episodes.title: Incident At The Factory
episodes.synopsis: Prince Soron oversees oppressive factory conditions while a disgruntled worker, Isaac, secretly sabotages the operation in retaliation.

episodes.title: Flames of A Oppressed System
episodes.synopsis: Soron risks his life to save a trapped factory worker from an explosion, sparking an argument with his father about the value of common lives.

episodes.title: Tales Of Ruin And Rubble
episodes.synopsis: A runaway prince sparks a continent-wide revolution that forces him to choose between peace, power, and the people he loves most.

episodes.title: What Is A Life Worth Living
episodes.synopsis: Wanted revolutionary Isaac goes on the run with his young daughter May, while across the sea, Omperia's king secretly holds Isaac's wife captive as his queen.

episodes.title: The Case Study of Class Standings
episodes.synopsis: Soron discovers Imperia's entire judicial system has been rigged against the lower classes, leading him to confront his father at swordpoint for the truth.

episodes.title: The Anguish of Fatherhood
episodes.synopsis: Isaac and May are recruited into a secret revolutionary bunker called The Tombs, while Ariel lectures Soron on the necessity of strength.

episodes.title: Omperia and Lands Not Ours
episodes.synopsis: Queen May secretly writes unsent letters to her family, while Soron recruits his best friend Clovis to smuggle himself overseas in a shipping box.

episodes.title: Skirmish at The Border
episodes.synopsis: A staged border attack by Ariel's forces creates political chaos, while Isaac grows suspicious of The Tombs' leader and its criminal point system.

episodes.title: Sea Of Thieves
episodes.synopsis: Soron and Lilith successfully smuggle Clovis onto a military ship, as Omperia's ruthless Captain Tottetin prepares to intercept their voyage.
